name: 17043 · Lemoyne, PA
findings: ZIP 17043 (Lemoyne) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (68%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17043 (Lemoyne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
